title: Tell your cousin about the party

scenario.en: Your cousin was not at the party yesterday. He asks you: how was it?
scenario.ar: ابن عمك مكانش في الحفلة إمبارح. سألك: كانت عاملة إيه؟

source: "The party was at my house on Friday. There were twenty people. The food was delicious. My uncle was very funny."

task.en: Tell your cousin about the party. Use was and were.
task.ar: احكي لابن عمك عن الحفلة. استخدم was و were.

model_answer.en: The party was at my house on Friday. There were twenty people, and the food was delicious.
model_answer.ar: الحفلة كانت في بيتي يوم الجمعة. كانوا عشرين واحد، والأكل كان لذيذ.
